rows.text: Prosper gives you a second card every turn and a Treasure every time you use one. That is the whole engine, and it compounds: the deck is packed with other impulse effects, and every single card played off exile makes another Treasure. Then the Treasures stop being mana and start being a win condition — ten of them under Revel in Riches, or ten sacrificed to Bolas's Citadel.

rows.name: Prosper, Tome-Bound
rows.text: exiles a card at your end step that you may play until the end of your NEXT turn — two turns of access, not one — and every card you play from exile makes a Treasure. Deathtouch on a 1/4 also means he blocks anything.
Watch the expiry. Cards exiled by Prosper vanish at the end of your next turn. Plan the mana so the expensive ones get cast; a wasted impulse is a wasted card and a missed Treasure.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: haste and shroud, because Prosper is the deck.
Every one of these makes a Treasure per card played, because Prosper does not care whose effect exiled it.

rows.name: Reckless Impulse
rows.text: two cards for two mana, and two Treasures when you play them.

rows.name: Jeska's Will
rows.text: with your commander out you take both halves — a huge mana burst AND three impulse cards.

rows.name: Outpost Siege
rows.text: a card every upkeep, forever.

rows.name: Chandra, Torch of Defiance
rows.text: an impulse card or two damage to each opponent, plus a ritual on the other plus.

rows.name: Etali, Primal Storm
rows.text: a free spell off every player's library on every attack — and every one of them is a Treasure.

rows.name: Professional Face-Breaker
rows.text: Treasures on combat damage, and it converts Treasures back into impulse draws.

rows.name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
rows.text: whenever opponents each lose EXACTLY one life, he grows and exiles a card you may play. Reckless Fireweaver and Mirkwood Bats both deal exactly one, so he fires constantly.

rows.name: Bolas's Citadel
rows.text: plays off the top of your LIBRARY rather than from exile, so it makes no Treasures — but it casts your whole deck for life, and then sacrifices ten Treasures to deal ten to each opponent.

rows.name: Academy Manufactor
rows.text: every Treasure you would make becomes a Clue, a Food AND a Treasure. Three artifacts instead of one, on every single Prosper trigger.

rows.name: Goldspan Dragon
rows.text: your Treasures tap for two mana each, and it makes more on attack and whenever anyone targets it.

rows.name: Pitiless Plunderer
rows.text: a Treasure for every creature that dies.

rows.name: Grim Hireling
rows.text: two per combat damage step, and it converts them into removal.

rows.name: Ruthless Technomancer
rows.text: turns a creature into Treasures equal to its power, then reanimates with them.

rows.name: Revel in Riches
rows.text: Treasures whenever THEIR creatures die, and ten Treasures at your upkeep simply wins the game. With Academy Manufactor, ten is two or three turns away.

rows.name: Reckless Fireweaver
rows.text: one damage to each opponent for every artifact that enters. With Academy Manufactor that is three per Prosper trigger.

rows.name: Marionette Apprentice
rows.text: a drain for every artifact or creature you lose — every Treasure you crack.

rows.name: Marionette Master
rows.text: the same, scaled to its power, which fabricate makes four.

rows.name: Mirkwood Bats
rows.text: a drain when you CREATE a token and again when you SACRIFICE it. Academy Manufactor turns one Treasure trigger into six points of drain.

rows.name: Mayhem Devil
rows.text: a damage every time any player sacrifices anything, yours included.

rows.name: Crime Novelist
rows.text: grows and makes red mana on every artifact you sacrifice.

rows.name: Hellrider
rows.text: one damage per attacking creature, which closes games the old-fashioned way.

rows.name: Rakdos Charm
rows.text: graveyard hate, artifact removal, or a symmetric ping that finishes a token board.

rows.name: Deadly Dispute
rows.text: two cards and a Treasure for a spare artifact, at instant speed. It is the best card in the deck alongside a board of Treasures.

rows.name: Big Score
rows.text: two cards and two Treasures.

rows.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
rows.text: feed it a Treasure or a Clue each end step and they either give up a permanent or you draw and they lose two.

rows.name: Skullclamp
rows.text: on a Servo or Faerie, two cards.

rows.name: Bitterblossom
rows.text: a free body every turn — Skullclamp fodder, Braids fodder, and a Mirkwood Bats trigger.

rows.name: Commander's Sphere
rows.text: mana now, a card later.

rows.name: Mind Stone
rows.text: the same.

rows.name: Necropotence
rows.text: as many cards as your life total allows.

rows.name: Phyrexian Arena
rows.text: a card a turn.

rows.name: Read the Bones
rows.text: two cards and a scry.

rows.name: Sign in Blood
rows.text: two cards, or two damage to a player at four life.

rows.name: Night's Whisper
rows.text: the cheap one.

rows.name: Bedevil
rows.text: artifact, creature or planeswalker, at instant speed.

rows.name: Dreadbore
rows.text: a creature or planeswalker for two.

rows.name: Infernal Grasp
rows.text: the cleanest black removal spell.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Feed the Swarm
rows.text: the only enchantment answer in Rakdos.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: the second one, and it handles planeswalkers too.

rows.name: Damnation
rows.text: a wrath in a deck whose value lives on artifacts and in exile.

rows.name: Blasphemous Act
rows.text: cheap, and your Treasures survive it.

rows.name: Light Up the Night
rows.text: scalable reach at any target, with a flashback for a second helping.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep mana and one impulse effect. Prosper on turn four with Reckless Impulse or Outpost Siege behind him starts the Treasure engine immediately; a hand of expensive payoffs does not.
Academy Manufactor is the single biggest upgrade. Every Treasure effect triples, so every drain payoff, every Fireweaver ping, and every Revel in Riches counter triples with it.
Do not spend Treasures freely once Revel in Riches is out. Ten is the number and it wins on your upkeep with no combat, no targeting and nothing they can respond to except artifact removal.

rows.name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
rows.text: play him before Reckless Fireweaver or Mirkwood Bats, not after. Every batch of exactly-one damage gives you a counter and another impulse card.
